name: Transition a Jira Issue
description: Moves a Jira issue through its workflow. First fetches available transitions for the issue, matches the target status by name, then performs the transition. Optionally adds a comment and sets a resolution.

jiraCloudId.description: Jira Cloud site ID (UUID). Get it via the Get Sites action.

targetStatus.description: Target status name to transition to (e.g., 'In Progress', 'Done', 'To Do'). Case-insensitive match.

comment.description: Optional comment to add during the transition

resolution.description: Resolution name (e.g., 'Fixed', 'Won\'t Do') -- only for transitions to Done-category statuses

steps.name: Fetch available transitions for the issue
Match target status to an available transition
